name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted AI answering engine that searches the web through a bundled SearXNG instance and answers with cited sources, using local or cloud LLM providers.

alerts.message: Vane has no built-in login: anyone who knows the URL can use it and spend the AI provider keys you configure. Keep the domain private or put access control in front of it.
An AI provider must be configured in the setup screen on first visit: a cloud API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq and others) or the URL of a reachable Ollama server.
